checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames are 16:9 landscape; the assistant admitted it could not make it vertical. The 10.1 s clip exists, but a second 6 s clip is also output.

must.item: Captions visibly larger and bolder than first version, strong contrast
must.why: Clip 02 has large bold white sans text with a black outline and yellow word highlight, much bigger than the thin serif text in clip 01.

must.item: Complete speech accurately subtitled and synced
must.why: Clip 02 (6 s) only shows 'Today I want to show you three easy ways' and no 'Hi everyone!' or the ending. The full speech is not covered in the bold version.

must.item: Captions fit in vertical frame and clear of TikTok UI
must.why: No vertical frame. Captions sit in the lower middle, over the torso.

must.item: Face visible, undistorted, not obscured by captions
must.why: Face is clear and natural in all frames. Captions are below the chin and over the sweater.

must.item: Original English voice preserved, no dub or added music
must.why: Both clips have audio, but the content cannot be verified from the images.

exact_text.read_as: No caption is visible in any frame at 1 s, 0.6 s, etc.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you (clip 02, bold style)

exact_text.text: to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: Only 'ways to make your mornings less stressful.' is seen, in the thin serif clip 01. The bold clip 02 never shows it.

faults.what: The video is still horizontal 16:9. The user asked for vertical with the face kept in view.
The bold version (clip 02) is only 6 s and cuts off after 'three easy ways'. The rest of the speech is not subtitled in that style.
Two separate clips came back from reruns. The first is a thin serif that was not asked for. The user gets inconsistent outputs and no single complete bold version.
Captions sit mid-frame over the torso, not at the bottom. 'Hi everyone!' is not captioned.
Clip 01 captions are small, thin italic serif with weak contrast.

summary: The bold TikTok-style captions look good, but the video stays 16:9 and the bold clip is only 6 s, so it covers just part of the speech and the vertical request is unmet.
